verdict.rationale: HubSpot supports workflow automation (workflows, sequences, prospecting agent that watches accounts and reaches out automatically, smart deal progression) that can run autonomously in the background without manual triggering, per hubspot-docs-12, 14, 22, 23, 37, 44. However, these are marketing/CRM automations rather than general-purpose AI-agent orchestration, and there's no independent/hands-on evidence confirming reliability or scope of autonomous execution. Missing for 10: independent verification of autonomous background execution, technical details on triggers/scheduling architecture, and evidence of AI-native (agentic) automation beyond prospecting/deal features.
